''See also: [[Endross Incarnation Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|[[Incarnations]] are powerful, noble beings that function as forces of nature. However, remaining in the world for extended periods causes them to lose their sanity, making them behave like rabid animals. The [[Endross]] [[Incarnation]] specifically functions as a natural disaster, capable of devastating landscapes and populations. This entity is fueled by rage, making the [[Territory]] of [[Asphodel]] a suitable counter because it feeds on emotions. Visually, an [[Endross]] [[Incarnation]] may possess stormcloud wings, eyes that resemble lightning bolts, and skin or limbs that glow with electricity. They are often associated with creatures that emerge from clouds of sparks and can manifest elemental powers like thunderstorms. While [[Incarnations]] are typically driven to madness, some have been known to act with unusual restraint or perform theatrical speeches. Historically, the first [[Endross]] [[Incarnation]] was defeated by a group of [[Travelers]], which led a follower to attempt the transformation himself to achieve demigod status. These beings are often kept imprisoned by [[Damasca]], and their liberation frequently results in a desire to destroy that nation.}}

== City of Light ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|After the second [[Endross]] [[Incarnation]] vanished and fell silent, [[Leah]] grew fearful that his violent moods could lead to the [[destruction]] of various outposts. Appearing as a man wreathed in blue-white lightning, he descended upon crowds to perform displays of light and sound. He later hovered over the [[Damascan camp]] using wings made of stormclouds, embodying the nature of an [[Incarnation]] by tearing through land and people like a natural disaster. This entity was ultimately part of a setup involving [[King Zakareth the Sixth]], participating in a staged contest against the monarch. During the ensuing battle, the [[Endross]] [[Incarnation]] served as the sole [[Incarnation]] present while attacking on wings of lightning and cloud.}}
